features: PTFE insulated electrode capable of withstanding 180°C
No moving parts, no mechanical wear and tear.
Adjustable differential time delay with ON/OFF timing.
Fail Safe High/Low Selection Feature (Field configurable)
Ignores Build Up of Sticky and Conductive Material between Probe and Vessel Walls
Probe Construction suitable for material built up:

Normal probe tends to fail when there is a build-up on the probe. The COAT Guard electrode senses the material build up on the probe by employing a special Build up sensing technology. The COAT guard unit is insulated from the active probe and the ground is driven with same RF frequency as that of active electrode and having the same polarity. When a material build up is formed on the probe, the RF current from the COAT guard unit tends to saturate the build-up area between COAT guard probe and silo wall, thereby no electrical energy will flow from active probe to tank wall. When the material level goes up and touches the sense probe a RF current will flow from the sense probe to ground over and above the saturated region formed by the Built-up sensing circuitry.

It is very compact and fits in constrained spaces. It is unaffected by
full_description: INFRA POINT LEVEL SWITCH INFRA LEVEL SWITCH instruments are suitable for the detection of liquid level in small vessels where space is limited. Level detection is unaffected by electrical and physical parameters of the media such as conductivity, dielectric constant, density, viscosity, air bubbles, color and refractive index. It is very compact and fits in constrained spaces. It is unaffected by vapour and can be easily removed, cleaned and reinstalled. It has no moving parts and can be used for the detection of level in chemical and Pharmaceutical industries, food processing, beverages, breweries, hydraulic fluids, oils, water and aqueous media.
operating_principle: An infrared emitter sends pulsed light into the prism. When the prism is not covered by the media, the light undergoes a total internal reflection and the returning beam is detected by the Photo Detector. When the Prism gets covered by the media the light is dispersed and only a weak beam returns to the Photo Detector. The change in the received intensity is processed by the electronics to signal an Alarm.
features: Selectable Fail-Safe mode for High- or Low-level Alarm.

full_description: Industrial grade RFLS-300L RF Admittance Level Switch designed for harsh process environments with high accuracy and low maintenance.
features: PTFE insulated electrode capable to withstand @ 180°C
No moving parts, no mechanical wear and tear.
Adjustable differential time delay with ON/OFF timing.
Fail Safe High/Low Selection Feature (Field configurable)
Ignores Build Up of Sticky and Conductive Material between Probe and Vessel Walls
Probe Construction suitable for material built up:

Normal probe tends to fail when there is a build-up on the probe. The COAT Guard electrode senses the material build up on the probe by employing a special Build up sensing technology. The COAT guard unit is insulated from the active probe and the ground is driven with same RF frequency as thatof active electrode and having the same polarity. When a material

build up is formed on the probe, the RF current from the COAT guard unit tends to saturate the build-up area between COAT guard probe and silo wall, thereby no electrical energy will flow from active probe to tank wall. When the material level goes up and touches the sense probe a RF current will flow from the sense probe to ground over and above the saturated region formed by the Built-up sensing circuitry.

0-250°C for Remote with Standoff, Ceramic type

Probe Length: As per requirement, Housing: Cast Al.
MOUNTINGFlanged or threaded process connection as per requirement. ENCLOSUREWeatherproof as per IP 68, Flameproof (optional)
TIME DELAY0 To 30 seconds adjustable with ON/OFF delay Selection
applications: The specialty of the probe is that it tends to ignore the build-up on the probe, thus making it suitable for application, which tends to stick on the probe.
The unit has integral electronics along with time delay feature, LED indication, fail safe mode etc.
